svg.title: delta-gated
svg.desc: Gated DeltaNet on the toy with α = 0.8 and β = 0.5: decay [2, 4] to [1.6, 3.2], read 1.6, residual 3.4, write 1.7, result [3.3, 3.2]. The grid gives S_t for α = 1, 0.8, 0 and β = 0, 0.5, 1: α = 1 is DeltaNet, α = 0 wipes the state before writing. Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B: 36 Gated DeltaNet layers and 12 gated-attention layers, 32 value heads × 128 × 128 = 524,288 state numbers per layer.

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: St = αt St-1 (I - βt kt kt ⊤ ) + βt vt kt ⊤

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: One step on the toy, for 3 × 3 gate settings
GDN heads: 16 for q, k · 32 for v, d = 128
short conv kernel 4 on q, k, v
α clears the whole head (cheap reset at a topic switch); β edits one association.
Scalar α also shrinks order 2208: 4 → 3.2. The next card fixes that per channel.
Olmo Hybrid 7B uses the same rule: 24 GDN + 8 attention layers, 30 heads, key dim 96, value dim 192.
